title: CatalogueLicenceWhere

path.description: The licence file's path from the repository's root, such as LICENSE, or cursor-team-kit/LICENSE where each folder has its own.

oneOf.description: Only a license key in the skills' SKILL.md frontmatter states it: no licence file.
Only the README states it: no licence file.

description: Where a skills entry's licence was declared: file (a licence file, by its path from the repository's root), frontmatter (a license key in SKILL.md, no file), readme (the README, no file) or none. A client shows a file plainly and anything else with a caution and the note.
